name: Mujhe Kyu Toda (Devendra Fadnavis Face Swap)
visual_description: A bruised and beaten man in a torn vest with politician Devendra Fadnavis's face edited on, surrounded by crying henchmen in construction helmets with the caption 'Mujhe kyu toda?'.
usage_context: Used to express confusion and distress after being unexpectedly punished, attacked, or caught in the crossfire of a situation you weren't involved in.

example.top_text: Me peacefully sitting in group chat getting roasted for no reason

text_areas.description: Caption explaining the situation where someone is unfairly targeted
